coaching.headline: An early 0-2 at Fangtooth bought tempo; we then won five straight fights to close the game.
coaching.team: The carry duo started even, 2 duo deaths apiece before 10, despite the matchup reading ours all game. We lost the 8.6 skirmish 0-2 near Fangtooth but kept the objective, then traded again at 14.2 for Fangtooth. From 18.6 on we won every fight: two Outer Towers, Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth, then their Core at 28.7. Towers finished 8-2.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: At 23.5, we won 4-0 at their Outer Tower; Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth both fell our way in the following two minutes.
coaching.whatWorked: We converted five of six won fights into objectives while the opponent cashed zero of three.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ability.name: Ambush
ability.what: Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+80%) physical damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.35s.

loadout.plain: Ambush reaches a bit farther, so you can start fights or finish a fleeing low target from a safer distance. Since Ambush hits harder on wounded enemies, the extra reach mostly wins chases.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: When you hit a hero below 30% health, missiles fire that pass through walls. With Ambush already hitting harder on wounded targets, it helps finish low enemies who try to run.

ability.name: Ambush
ability.what: Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+80%) physical damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.35s.

loadout.plain: Ambush reaches a bit farther, so you can start fights or finish a fleeing low target from a safer distance. Since Ambush hits harder on wounded enemies, the extra reach mostly wins chases.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.

loadout.name: Wind-Rider

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players Greystone killed built physical armor (Riktor).

copy.text: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 49.9% in 3,846 Greystone offlane games, below the hero's 51.7%; this 3-item core: 50.1% in 473 games, below the 53.9% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

loadout.text: Make Way deals 20% increased damage to the nearest Enemy Unit.

ability.name: Make Way
ability.what: Summon a fiery whirlwind that deals 90/145/200/255/310 (+90%)(+80%) physical damage over 4s.

loadout.plain: Make Way hits the nearest enemy harder. Stand on your target with the whirlwind to get the most from it.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: The hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. Great in Greystone's long side-lane duels.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Small extra damage on every hit that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you. Helps in long trades.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: The longer you stay in a fight, the faster you attack, with no cap. Fits Greystone's long brawls.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: An area hit around you that heals you on hero hits. Use it with Make Way in the middle of a fight to top up.
